html:
The Nukak are a small nomadic people of the Guaviare region of Colombia, between the Guaviare and Inírida rivers, at the edge of the Amazon forest. Their language is related to that of the Yuhup and the Hupda.

They live by hunting with blowguns, fishing and gathering, and move camp often. They kept almost no contact with the outside world until 1988, when a group walked into the town of Calamar. Flu and other diseases then killed many of them. Since the 1990s coca growing and the armed conflict between guerrillas, paramilitaries and the army have driven many Nukak from their forest into camps near San José del Guaviare.
